answer.reason: The Keilah story in 1 Samuel 23 tells what happened there: David delivered the town from the Philistines and then left it when the LORD said its men would give him up.

clauses.english: was saved from the Philistines by David, who smote them with a great slaughter
clauses.quote: So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

clauses.english: was where David learned its men would deliver him up to Saul, and he departed

doubts: JOS 15:44, 1CH 4:19 and NEH 3:17-18 only list the place or its rulers, or name a man called the father of Keilah, so they were not used.
